swe1_target.basis: Requirement Studio SWE.1 Authoring Guide V0.2
swe1_target.hierarchy: Feature > SRS > Detailed Behavior (BF retained internally)
swe1_target.srs_rule: One SRS per independently testable software requirement; SRS IDs are assigned SRS_001... after deterministic Canonical merge and reused by all SWE.1 outputs.
swe1_target.no_fabrication: Unsupported facts remain internal review flags or blank/Not Confirmed; they are not invented to complete final output.
swe1_target.traceability_view: Input Source / Requirement -> SWE.1 SRS -> SWE.6 Test Case ID
swe1_target.other_field_rule: 기타에는 Source-backed Figure/Diagram/Table/auxiliary material만 표시하며 없으면 공란으로 둔다.
swe1_target.review_view_rule: Final 01_SWE1 remains concise; Source-backed applicability, exceptions, dependencies, gaps/conflicts, coverage and review details must remain visible in dedicated Review View sheets or the Word Review Annex.
swe1_target.no_silent_loss_rule: Review-relevant Canonical fields must be dispositioned to Final View, Review View, or explicit Internal-only status; unmapped data is EXPORT_INFORMATION_LOSS.

swe6_target.basis: Requirement Studio SWE.6 Authoring Guide V0.1
swe6_target.traceability: One requirement may derive zero, one, or many test cases.
specification_fields: Methods for Testing / Method for deriving TC
Test preparation: Description / Variable / Compare / Value
Test execution: Description / Variable / Compare / Value
Expected Result: Description / Variable / Compare / Value
swe6_target.pre_execution_rule: All four execution result fields must remain blank before test execution. N/A is allowed only in design-side Variable/Compare/Value when Source cannot concretize them.
swe6_target.test_method_rule: Requirement-based testing is the base method; boundary/equivalence/state-transition technique is selected locally from Canonical Requirement characteristics.
swe6_target.provider_independence: SWE.6 workbook derivation runs locally from Canonical Requirement and is not generated by a provider-specific SWE.6 prompt.
swe6_target.na_rule: For Test Preparation/Execution/Expected Result Variable/Compare/Value, use N/A only when the block description exists but the value cannot be derived from Source. Do not fill intentionally blank user-result fields with N/A.
swe6_target.source_fidelity_rule: Source-backed key behavior/value/prohibition facts must remain visible in TC Description/Execution/Expected Result or an explicit Deferred Intent. Do not normalize ambiguous source wording into an unsupported comparator.
swe6_target.atomicity_rule: A parent SRS may keep one draft Normal TC, but multiple source-backed atomic behaviors are exposed as child verification intents so one generic PASS cannot silently imply complete atomic coverage.
swe6_target.interface_fact_allocation_rule: Interface bitrate/NM/configuration facts require explicit software-allocation evidence before SWE.6 eligibility; otherwise defer to interface allocation review.
swe6_target.export_audit: SWE.6-specific preservation audit covers SRS/TC trace, allocation-pending deferred governance, child-intent disposition, canonical Source-fact provenance, cross-domain bundle review, and actual XLSX verification.
swe6_target.deferred_allocation_rule: SWE.6 allocation-pending requirements retain at least one auditable deferred intent with ALLOCATION_PENDING; empty deferred arrays never count as complete governance.
swe6_target.child_intent_disposition_rule: Each source-backed child intent is dispositioned as REPRESENTED_IN_GENERIC_TC, INDEPENDENTLY_COVERED, DEFERRED, or REVIEW_REQUIRED. Independent coverage requires a structured input/observation criterion relevant to that child intent.
swe6_target.cross_domain_fact_rule: Mixed non-SW facts remain one parent review bundle by default. Fact-level allocation records preserve Electrical/Environmental/Manufacturing/Mechanical verification responsibility without automatic SRS splitting.
swe6_target.derived_verification_method_rule: Verification-method candidates not stated in Source may be proposed only with knowledge_state=DERIVED and must not be represented as Source facts.
swe6_target.table_fact_value_role_rule: Source Table facts are classified as SINGLE_REQUIRED_VALUE, TIMING_CRITERION, ENUM_MAPPING, RANGE_CONSTRAINT, INVALID_MARKER, ENCODING_RULE, or SOURCE_LITERAL_ONLY. Only the first two may be auto-used in TC Variable/Compare/Value with HIGH-confidence requirement linkage.
swe6_target.source_fact_fragment_rule: Compound Semantic Source Units are conservatively split at sentence/newline/bullet boundaries into stable fact fragments so each SRS owns only the Source clause it actually uses. Conflicting multi-SRS allocation of the same fragment is a release-review issue.
swe6_target.unsupported_audit_scope: Unsupported-generation token audit evaluates factual assertion values only; schema keys, provenance keys, knowledge-state labels, and empty applicability containers are excluded.

handoff_files: 03_<selected actual SWE.1 Word or SWE.6 Excel>
review_exchange.principle: Keep Source and Review Package from the same run; select only the engineer-facing file-3 artifact according to the evaluation objective. No automatic external transmission.
